title: Historical migration, version 0
description: One SQL Server source the factory migrates into the archive store with SnowConvert AI: where the source is, which schemas move, how the tool is invoked for each phase, and where the converted schema lands. Secrets are named by environment variable, never written here.

id.description: Names the release bundle <id>-migration and the run directory.

platform.description: SnowConvert AI source platform; only SQL Server is driven for now.

server.description: Host name of the SQL Server instance, for the record; the connection string is the secret.

schemas.description: Source schemas extracted, converted and migrated.

connection_env.description: Environment variable holding the SQL Server connection string. The value is never written to the repository or a log.

schema.description: Archive-store schema of the environment database; ARCHIVE in the foundation.

table_prefix.description: Prefix for every converted table, for example LEGACY_.

command.description: The SnowConvert AI CLI executable and any leading arguments; astra-data migrate --tool overrides it.

license_env.description: Environment variable holding the SnowConvert AI license key, when the CLI needs one on the command line ({license}).

version_args.description: Arguments that print the tool's version; recorded with every run.

converted_ddl.description: Glob, relative to the convert output directory, of the converted DDL files.

phases.description: Arguments per phase, after the command. Placeholders: {connection} {license} {schemas} {source_server} {source_port} {source_database} {database} {target_schema} {work_dir} {extract_dir} {convert_dir} {migrate_dir} {validate_dir}.
